text: おれも　おまえに　まけない　ポケモンを　そだてて　おくぜ！

structure.jp: おまえに　まけない　ポケモンを
structure.en: Pokémon that won't lose to you

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おまえに　まけない　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb comes right before the noun and describes it. おまえに まけない ポケモン = 'Pokémon that won't lose to you'.

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: おく after a て form says you do something ahead of time, to be ready for later. そだてて おく = 'raise them in preparation'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, confident male speech. そだてて おくぜ = 'I'll get them raised, you bet!'.
